summary: Exhaustive QA sweep across all 23 routes + backend regression. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed. Frontend: no console errors, no 4xx/5xx network failures, no broken images, no duplicate data-testids on any route, all H1 counts = 1, all meta description/canonical/og:title counts = 1, all JSON-LD parses cleanly. Sticky header stays at top:0 with rgb(10,15,26) at scrollY=0/500/2000. Contact E2E succeeds: POST /api/enquiries → 201 and [data-testid=thanks] renders 'Thank you — we'll be in touch soon.' FAQ accordion toggles aria-expanded false→true correctly. Sitemap has 23 URLs, robots.txt references sitemap. Nav has aria-label='Primary', skip link present on every route. Found 3 real bugs described below (duplicate <title> element, dead /services/outdoor-living slug listed in sitemap, and horizontal overflow on Contact/Services at some viewports).

ui_bugs.issue: Every page has TWO <title> elements in <head>. document.querySelectorAll('title').length === 2 on all 23 routes. The static <title> in /app/frontend/public/index.html (line 19) is NOT being replaced by react-helmet-async — Helmet appends a second <title>. document.title correctly reflects the Helmet value, but the extra tag is a real SEO/spec violation. Review request explicitly flagged: 'ensure no leftover static SEO tags in served HTML that would duplicate Helmet output.'

/services/outdoor-living is listed in sitemap.xml but the slug 'outdoor-living' does not exist in services[] in /app/frontend/src/lib/data.js. Visiting the URL renders the generic /services parent page (title falls back to 'Apollo Builders Services — New Home Builds, Renovations, Kitchens, Bathrooms', H1 = 'Our services.'). Broken deep link that Google will crawl.

issues: Horizontal scroll: scrollWidth=370 vs clientWidth=320 (50px overflow). Likely a form/grid element with fixed min-width or non-responsive padding.
Horizontal scroll: scrollWidth=1088 vs clientWidth=1024 (64px overflow). Two-column layout (form + Speak-with-the-team) not collapsing correctly at iPad-landscape breakpoint.
Minor horizontal scroll: scrollWidth=775 vs clientWidth=768 (7px overflow). Likely a service tile with padding overshooting the container.

action_items: Remove the static <title>Apollo Builders — Renovations & Custom Homes, Melbourne South-East</title> from /app/frontend/public/index.html (line 19) OR ensure Helmet writes into the same node. This eliminates duplicate <title> tags across all 23 routes.

Fix /services/outdoor-living: EITHER add an 'outdoor-living' entry to services[] in /app/frontend/src/lib/data.js (with title/tagline/bullets/hero/description matching the Home Renovations tagline that already mentions 'outdoor living spaces'), OR remove <url><loc>https://apollobuilders.com.au/services/outdoor-living</loc></url> from /app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml (and drop back to 22 URLs).

Investigate horizontal overflow on /contact at widths 320 and 1024 — likely input fields, a grid gap, or the right-side 'Speak with the team' column not stacking soon enough. On /services at 768 there is a 7px overshoot, likely tile padding.

Optional: index.html only carries a single static <title>; consider also removing any static <meta name='description'> or og tags there if they exist (I did not observe duplicates for those but worth an audit while fixing the title issue).
critical_code_review_comments: public/index.html has a hard-coded <title> that duplicates Helmet output. In a React-Helmet-async SPA the initial HTML should not contain a <title> or the Helmet component must be configured to overwrite it — right now two <title> nodes coexist on every route (verified via querySelectorAll('title').length === 2).

sitemap.xml is hand-maintained and drifted from data.js: the outdoor-living slug is advertised but not implemented. Consider deriving sitemap.xml at build-time from services[]/suburbData/resources data to prevent drift.
The static <title> in index.html means the initial render pre-Helmet-mount will flash the Home title on every route (FOUC of title). Removing it will let Helmet own it end-to-end.

Robots.txt Sitemap: line points to the production apollobuilders.com.au domain, not the preview URL. This is correct for production but means preview crawlers will not find the sitemap — acceptable trade-off.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% — 3 legitimate frontend bugs found across 23 routes and 5 viewports

seed_data_creation: Two test enquiries inserted via /api/enquiries during E2E verification (name='TEST_QA_ReviewBot' and 'TEST_i14b'). Backend pytest also inserted TEST_ prefixed enquiries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For duplicate <title> detection use: document.querySelectorAll('title').length — must equal 1 after the fix. document.title itself is fine (Helmet wins). For sitemap/route drift use: fetch /sitemap.xml, extract /services/* URLs, cross-check against services[] slugs in data.js. Contact-form submission works end-to-end with a >3s wait before submit; [data-testid=thanks] appears on success. Sticky-header background is rgb(10,15,26) and stays at top:0.
rca of the issue: 1) Duplicate <title>: index.html ships with a hard-coded <title> tag. react-helmet-async v2 does not remove the initial <title> — it inserts its own tag, so both nodes remain in <head>. Remove line 19 of public/index.html (or leave an empty title tag if you want a fallback). 2) /services/outdoor-living dead link: sitemap.xml was updated to advertise outdoor-living but services[] in data.js was never extended with that slug; the Services.jsx page falls back to the parent listing when useParams().slug does not match. Fix by either adding the service to data.js or trimming sitemap.xml. 3) Horizontal overflow: Contact page 2-column layout and 320px form inputs have fixed widths/padding that exceed viewport; needs responsive grid stacking or container queries.
